notes.title: 🧙‍♂️ Dwarven Skykeep is a new Dwarf Tower incarnation
notes.content:
What could be better than quality pixel art and a non-trivial indie game?

￼🧙‍♂️ Dwarven Skykeep - ironic base building strategy with deep gameplay, Dwarves and beer.

Dwarven Skykeep is a new and improved version of Dwarf Tower. Everything that you loved in the past incarnation remains, and many new features are coming!

It's very simple: build a magic Tower and defend it from enemies at night.

Enemies burn books in Libraries, and rain drowns basements. Friendly Dwarfs are ready to help.
You cast spells, they repair.
🍻 You provide beer and they fight the Goblins.

Finally, catch the Sun Spark with the Mirror. Until the Goblins broke it.

🧙‍♂️Dwarven Skykeep is:
- replayable levels
- deck building
- metroidvania style
- original soundtrack
- cool pixel art
- deep plot with humor

👉 Follow the game news and add Dwarven Skykeep to your Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1076120/Dwarven_Skykeep/

notes.title: Dwarf Tower 1.4 Released
notes.content:
Dwarf Tower 1.4 is now available in Steam!

Also in:
mac app store: https://itunes.apple.com/app/dwarf-tower/id834362804?ct=14release
humble store: http://www.palmkingdoms.com/en/dt.html
google play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.palmheroes.dwarftower&referrer=utm_source%3D14release
ios app store: https://itunes.apple.com/app/apple-store/id867438565?mt=8

Totally cross-platform multiplayer!

Besides, we have improved the gameplay significantly:
 - A new Alchemy Lab room allow to change spells. Beware though, it can explode if used frequently!
 - Random terrain generator
 - More spells on later turns
 - You can target Fireball
 - You can target Rats
 - Armor helps agains Landslide
 - When placing or moving blocks or rooms you can now read the floor and the room power

 What next? We are working on the next version of Dwarf Tower. Here is the feature list:
  - A strategic map mode. Manage multiple towers and resources across them.
  - More than 2 players combat + Observer mode
  - Improved AI

  Stay tuned. Please subscribe to our newsletter:
  http://palmkingdoms.com/signup

notes.title: 1.2 Major Update
notes.content:
Here is the next big update for you, Dwarf Tower lovers!

What we've got?

[list]
[*]Steam Multiplayer; you can now play with your friends right on Steam!
[*]Fire spell is now targeted
[*]Disturbance spell is now targeted (if there was a Crystal it explodes)
[*]Flood spell power is reduced to 1 block of water
[*]Rain now has a chance to put out a fire
[*]New Observatory room
[*]New Anti-Eye spell
[*]Deck Editor for real geeks. You can even play with your friends using customized rules!
[*]A lot of other improvements and tweaks. The game just got better!
[/list]

What to expect in the next update? Some underworld fun. What hides beneath your tower? 
Want more? How about a campaign mode? Stay tuned. Thanks for all your support!

notes.title: The First Update
notes.content:
Hello Dwarf Tower fans! Thank you all for your interest in our game!

Here is our first minor update:
[list]
 [*]we fixed the tutorial
 [*]several crashes has been exterminated
 [*]overal network game stability improved
 [*]music support on Windows XP significantly improved
 [*]the Reflector room is now unlocked by default (no Facebook liking required)
[/list]
What next? We are working hard to integrate Steam SDK so you can play with your friends via Steam!
Stay tuned!
